_doc: iter_016 ABLATION = T119. Built on T109 v3 pkg with two changes: (1) T95 GRU completely removed from h=60 stack, (2) h=5/10/20/40 disabled (action=1 / flat). Rationale: iter_016 v3 platform (+25.08) underperformed iter_015 v1 (+28.16) despite +4.6 LOSO lift on local 442k -> reverse signal indicates v3 over-tuned local. Removing GRU + short-horizon DE thresh (the two main local-only tuning vectors) gives a more conservative variant. h=60 thresholds set to 4.21e-4 / 1.86e-4 (iter_015 v1-style conservative, NOT v3 aggressive 2.88e-4 / 2.19e-4).
